title: Gutenberg's printing press
examples: What was the biggest change the printing press brought?
How did movable type work before Gutenberg?
Did the printing press only help in Europe?

explain.say: The first important idea is movable type.
Now let me show you the real thing in 3D: Gutenberg's printing press. Look at the bar, the screw and the platen. Tap any part, and I will tell you what it does.
Before this, scribes had to write every letter by hand.
Johannes Gutenberg developed his press around the year 1440.
This invention allowed books and new ideas to spread much faster.
A concrete example is the printing of the Bible.
In everyday life, think about school textbooks today.

faq.q: Did Gutenberg invent printing all by himself?
faq.a: No, he improved existing technologies significantly. He combined movable type with a mechanical press.
asks: Was it just one person's idea?

faq.q: What was the biggest impact on learning?
faq.a: It made books affordable for more people, leading to increased literacy rates everywhere.
asks: Did everyone suddenly learn to read?

faq.q: Was this change immediate across all countries?
faq.a: No, the technology spread gradually over many decades after its invention.
asks: Did it happen everywhere at once?
How long did it take to spread?

faq.q: What was the main difference between scribes and printers?
faq.a: Scribes wrote by hand, which was slow. Printers used mechanical types to reproduce text quickly.
asks: What was the main limitation of handwriting?
What did the press do that hands could not?

faq.q: What was the main purpose of the early printing press?
faq.a: Initially, it was used heavily for religious texts, like Bibles, before spreading to secular works.
asks: What was the first big use?

facts: Movable type allowed individual characters to be rearranged.
Gutenberg's press significantly sped up the process of book production.
The spread of printed materials was a key factor in the Renaissance.
The invention was around the year 1440.

quiz.say: What was the main advantage of movable type?
quiz.show: A. It used only expensive materials.

options.show: B. It allowed letters to be reused many times.
options.say: B. It allowed letters to be reused many times.

options.show: A. It was only used for religious texts.
options.say: A. It was only used for religious texts.

options.show: C. It required highly trained scribes.
options.say: C. It required highly trained scribes.

options.show: D. It was invented before the year 1000.
options.say: D. It was invented before the year 1000.

quiz.why: Reusing letters made printing much faster and cheaper than writing everything by hand.

wrong.1: While early use was religious, it soon printed many other subjects.
wrong.2: The press replaced the need for scribes to write every single letter.
wrong.3: The correct time frame for this major invention was much later, around 1440.

quiz.say: If a book was printed using movable type, what must have been true?

options.show: Solid wood blocks for every page.
options.say: Solid wood blocks for every page.

quiz.why: Movable type means the individual letters could be taken apart and put together again.

wrong.1: Wood blocks were used before, but movable type was the improvement.
wrong.2: The point of the press was to move away from single-person writing.
wrong.3: The press helped make books from cheaper materials more accessible.

quiz.say: The ability to quickly reproduce texts mainly helped which period?
quiz.why: The Renaissance was a time when new ideas needed to spread rapidly to many people.

wrong.1: Writing and printing were concepts that developed much later than the Stone Age.
wrong.2: While writing existed, the mechanical printing press was a much later development.
wrong.3: Ancient civilizations used different methods, not the movable type press.
